rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that someone intends or plans to do something.

example.english: I intend to go see a movie tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 tai2 hei3

rows.note: Use this when presenting the intention as a more deliberate or definite plan.

example.english: I intend to start learning Japanese next month.
example.traditional: 我打算下個月開始學日文。
example.jyutping: ngo5 daa2 syun3 haa6 go3 jyut6 hoi1 ci2 hok6 jat6 man4
